programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: In The Fantastic Magic Baby, director Chang Che weaves a wild and woolly yarn about how the legendary Monkey King and Goddess of Mercy battle and defeat the child god Hung Hai-erh then point him down the road to righteousness.

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: A rich boy obsessed with martial arts encounters a mysterious man who teaches him combat skills, allowing him to win in a duel and marry his love.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: A bizarre yet beautiful fantasy, starring Lin Dai as a goddess who falls in love with a scholar. 14 years later their son seeks to unravel the mystery.

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: Cheng Tai-Nan (Kara Hui) is an honest and faithful servant of a dying patriarch who wants nothing more than to protect his vast wealth from his selfish, conniving nephew, Yung-Sheng.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: Two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and become patriotic heroes accidentally. Assisted by a warlords daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Kuo Tsing wins the hand of fair maiden Huang Yung. Almost immediately, however, clan rivalries leads to Kuo being wounded by Ouyang Feng and Huang being named new leader of the Beggar Clan.

programme.title: The Comedy Of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sisters wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman.

programme.title: Angel With The Iron Fists
programme.desc: A father whose daughter is killed by the Devil Girls Gang, goes in search of justice.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel and she hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: A sickly wife and maid conspire to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: During the Song dynasty, after the upright prefect Bao Zheng executed Pang Yu for embezzlement, the grand tutor Pang Ji sent assassins to avenge his sons death.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: Three North Shaolin teachers (Lu Feng, Chang Sheng, and Sun Chien) are called on by the Manchus to teach their soldiers and urged to challenge the current South Shaolin teachers. They defeat the South Shaolin teachers and, that night, the head general (Wang Lung Wei) kills the South Shaolin teachers and blames their deaths on the North Shaolin teachers. The South Shaolin master sends more of his pupils, who are killed accidentally by the North Shaolin teachers. He finally sends two more (Wei Pai and Lo Meng) of his students to train with old masters and trains one student (Kuo Chui) himself with the goal of finally defeating the North Shaolin experts.

programme.title: The Kingdom And The Beauty
programme.desc: Starlet Linda Lin Dai gives an acclaimed performance as a country girl who embarks on a forbidden relationship with Emperor Cheng-Te, whom she would love for the rest of her life.

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: When the "godfather of the kung-fu film" Chang Cheh decided to tell their stories with Alexander Fu Sheng, Chen Kuan-tai, and Chi Kuan-chun in the roles, it was cause for celebration. This film is one of the most beloved in the directors filmography. Each hero is given his own story, when they all come together in a final, day-long battle with hundreds of troops, the effect is unforgettable.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servants confusion.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: The Shaolin Temple is the last place to resist defeat by the Manchu Dynasty, mostly because of their unique fighting style. Men from far and wide come to wait outside the temple, hoping that they will be admitted as pupils. As the Abbot becomes older, he realizes that the Manchus are determined to destroy the temple and eradicate the Shaolin fighting techniques. To this end, he decides that it is time at last to admit worthy men into the temple as students, to learn the way of Shaolin.

programme.title: Adv. Of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: A rightful emperor disguises himself as a commoner and works together with a hoodlum to plot against corrupt politicians and punish them.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: A group of young elite commandos, led by Captain Drummond are tasked with collecting highly classified information that can change the fate of the war.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Another film inspired by the Chinese classic tale Journey to the West. This memorable version presents a unique interpretation with humour, action, and fantasy galore.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: A gang of ex-military guys are hired by a mysterious dame who wants them to go into Cambodia and kidnap the assassin who killed her father.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: In Pale Passion, Chin Ping-hsings only directed film, the gorgeous Chiang Li-ping plays a scorned wife Ah Hsia in an unsettling tale about cheating, adultery and blatant abuse, which develops into a deadly love triangle.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Zhang is a Bond-like international spy who must find the headquarters of a villainous crime organization by seducing their boss daughter, Julie Tan.

programme.title: Lovers Rock
programme.desc: Love triangle torturing the four youngsters. The story happens on a fish port in Taiwan, whereas there are many stones resemble female figures which people call them lover stone.

programme.title: Songfest
programme.desc: Shot on location at Taiwans beautiful Sun-Moon Lake, its the turbulent romance of a passionate tea picker and a debonair fisherman.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: This prime example of director/co-writer Chang Chehs mastery takes place right after the Korean War, as a kung-fu master, combat instructor, explosives expert, and missle specialist heroically represent the Book of Revelations four riders against murder, corruption, jealous and greed.

programme.title: Martial Arts of Shaolin
programme.desc: Zhi Ming, who trains at the Northern Shaolin Temple, teams up with Si Ma Yan, who trains at the Southern Shaolin Temple, to avenge both their fathers’ death by assassinating a corrupt magistrate, leading to a series of fierce battles!

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lians wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao’s home and he treats her poisonous wound.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, however, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf for winning the lantern contest. At the same time, Zhao plans for revenge.

programme.title: Love And Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says “yes”. Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliffs ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: The Sunny Side Of The Street
programme.desc: Hassans father has died in a car accident. A local taxi driver, Yat, then helps him flee Hong Kong. They gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the shocking truth about his fathers death.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: An emergency occurs on an offshore drilling rig that would cause it to capsize and sink. The Emergency Response Unit races against the clock in a chopper rescue mission amidst dangerous explosions and fire.

programme.title: The Lady Iron Chef
programme.desc: Beer girl and part-time model Ceci has terrible cooking skills. Coming from a well-off family that owns a big culinary business, wealthy SK meets Ceci in a gourmet competition held by his familys company. Despite their different backgrounds, Ceci and SK fall for each other. However, SKs dominating mother disapproves of their relationship. To win over her future mother-in-law, Ceci must beat her rival Jade in a gourmet showdown…

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol.

programme.title: Only Cloud Knows
programme.desc: This romantic drama is based on the story of a real-life couple. It follows a grieving husband as he journeys to places of significance to his beloved dead wife across their New Zealand homeland.

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: Two young men become involved in a complicated crime involving antique watches.

programme.title: Lonely Eighteen
programme.desc: Set in the 1980s Hong Kong, Elaine and her best friend Ying enter the entertainment industry hoping to change their fates from poverty. Ying soon becomes a popular porn star but Elaine is lost between being her true self and an actress. When show business declines after a decade, their choices lead them to two different paths in life.

programme.title: Death Stranding
programme.desc: To overhaul the underground gambling industry, the police join hands with the gambling association to crack down on illegal casinos. They auction off new casino licenses to regulate the industry, but this results in an upheaval in the gambling world, unveiling the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: The bus driver got injured while rescuing one of the boys at school bus accident. To thank the driver, the boys dad, brings him to live with the family. But soon discovers strange behaviours from them.

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love.

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette
programme.desc: A retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian man who carries a bag of stolen drugs.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: An unknown film director who is pursuing his dream and unremittingly pursuing a career in film.

programme.title: The Unwavering Brotherhood
programme.desc: Torn between loyalty to his crime boss and friendship, a young gangster faces a harrowing choice that could shatter his life irrevocably.

programme.title: Knight Of Shadows: Yin and Yang
programme.desc: Pu Song Ling, a legendary demon hunter, is asked to investigate a case involving missing teenage village girls with Constable Yan Fei and accidentally discover a mysterious love between a knight and a female ghost.

programme.title: My Kung Fu Sweetheart
programme.desc: Phoenix’s (Cecilia Cheung) parents are martial arts superheroes, who hide their true identities while ferreting out evil martial artists. Phoenix gets the go-ahead to train in the misty mountains, where she learns of her all-important romantic destiny...

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: A debt-ridden wedding planner inadvertently becomes a successful funeral planner, but he must convince a traditional Taoist priest of his legitimacy to continue operating in the field.

programme.title: Sex And The Beauties
programme.desc: It is said that Hong Kong is a sexy and sexual city where life is breathtakingly fast but glamorous. Fear of marriage, single and successful psychiatrist, Selina and other beauties seek for love and happy endings.

programme.title: Chasing The Dragon (2020)
programme.desc: Xu, a rookie officer, manages to solve a robbery case but gets demoted for offending a corrupt senior. He attempts to rise through the ranks by winning the heart of a rich woman.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Eva’s mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mother’s wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Eva’s heart?

programme.title: Legally Declared Dead
programme.desc: Sean visits Tak and Lings home to follow up on a life insurance case and is shocked to see their sons corpse hanging above him. He suspects Tak and Ling of murdering their son to claim the insurance money.

programme.title: All U Need Is Love
programme.desc: Ten major film companies join forces on a comedy-drama film to raise funds and create jobs for industry workers during the COVID-19 pandemic. This film features an all-star ensemble cast starring for free, with the story revolving around a group of hotel guests placed under quarantine in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: The only daughter of policeman Lok Jat Jin was murdered, and the method of killing was extremely cruel. All of this pointed to the desperate criminal Sung Ging Naam.

programme.title: Dont Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao suffers from amnesia and forgets about everything that happens yesterday when he wakes up the next day. When Lu Yao meets psychotherapist Xing Yue, they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together.

programme.title: Find Your Voice
programme.desc: The passion choir pilot program trains students from three underperforming schools choir to participate in an inter-school choral competition.

programme.title: Love Is Blind, Hate Too
programme.desc: Bo lost her eye sight in a serious car accident a year ago. One day, an intruder enters Bos house and takes her hostage. Then, she discovers her husbands secret which is related to her accident last year.

programme.title: Love Never Ends
programme.desc: An empty-nest elderly man and a widowed elderly woman who collects scrap, meet unexpectedly and gradually develop feelings for each other. An elderly couple whose wife suffers from a serious illness, makes a living by selling scrap. Both these elderly couples fall deeply in love and prove that love never ends, even if there is no tomorrow!

programme.title: The White Storm 3: Heaven Or...
programme.desc: An undercover cop who invade a drug cartel led by a notorious Thai drug lord. In classic heroic bloodshed fashion, the two develop a bond of brotherhood.

programme.title: iGirl
programme.desc: Ekin Cheng and Chrissie Chau reunite in this romantic-comedy about three heartbroken men who each purchase an iGirl, the latest smart-robot, as their new girlfriends.

programme.title: Treasure Hunt
programme.desc: Peggy shoots an ad on a deserted island while some mysterious men with the treasure map are also there to hunt for the hidden Ming Dynasty treasures. However, the map is stolen by Star who lives on the island.

programme.title: Detective Vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves “The Chosen Sleuths". Former top detective Lee vows to bring the brutal killers to justice and prove himself to be the real “Chosen Sleuth” instead of a lunatic.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kikos life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Hafizah
programme.desc: Since childhood, Hafizah ( Olivia Jensen ) has lived in an orphanage without knowing who her parents are. Many people like her simple, cheerful and tomboyish attitude. Unfortunately, on her 18th birthday, Hafizah had to leave the orphanage according to applicable regulations. Hafizahs life changed. He is invited to work at the house of Widuri ( Ade Irawan ), a rich grandmother who is known for being fierce and angry. Hafizahs outspoken attitude resulted in her often clashing with Widuri. Surya ( Ferry Salim ), Widuris son, and wife, Vani ( Cut Tari ), persuade Hafizah to feel at home working. In fact, its not only Widuri who has to be faced, but also Ryan ( Galih Ginanjar ), his grandson. Ryans reckless behavior causes them to often fight. Slowly, Hafizah learned that Ryans behavior was because his parents household was unhappy.

programme.title: Office
programme.desc: The investigation following a sales manager brutally killing his entire family leads to a track of mystery and tragedy in an overwhelmed work team at Seoul.

programme.desc: Follows Korean independence activists who launched a daring attack in Harbin against the Japanese to gain their countrys independence.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: "Mama" follows three different families all dealing with different issues affecting their mothers. Dong-Sook (Uhm Jung-Hwa) is a single mother who works as a saleswoman for yogurt drinks and also works cleans apartments to make ends meet. Her world revolves around her son Won-Jae (Lee Hyung-Suk), who is afflicted with a disease that prevents him from walking. One day, Dong-Sook is diagnosed with cancer and her world comes crashing down. Eun-Sung (Ryu Hyun-Kyung) has always lived under the shadows of her famous opera singer mother Hee-Kyung (Jeon Su-Kyeong).
